910: Fund every trade at creation and refuse unsupported escrow modes

I made trade creation always lock the seller's full amount plus the escrow fee in the same transaction that opens the trade, so no trade can be committed in Created without its lock. Offers and trades that use the unsupported on_chain or offer_escrow modes are now refused with 422 unsupported_escrow_type before anything is written, and the refusal is recorded under the 920 request-key contract. PATCH /trades/{id}/status can no longer mark a trade escrow_funded for any caller, and the on-chain escrow link route is refused. I moved the integration fixtures that relied on unfunded on_chain offers to funded custodial offers without weakening any assertion, added tests for every acceptance case including concurrent trade starts, and updated the design docs.

Ticket-Id: 6acd983a914864e091d819ad
